description: MediaPipe Tasks models used by Dragon Ball Powers. Downloaded and verified (size + SHA256) by scripts/download_models.py, which setup.bat runs. Published by Google (MediaPipe) under the Apache License 2.0.

models.description: Hand Landmarker (float16, version 1): palm detector + 21 3D landmarks per hand, up to two hands. Drives every gesture.
Pose Landmarker lite (float16, version 1): 33 body landmarks + segmentation mask. Fastest variant, the default (tracking.pose_model = lite).
Pose Landmarker full (float16, version 1): more accurate, slower (tracking.pose_model = full).
Pose Landmarker heavy (float16, version 1): most accurate, needs a fast CPU (tracking.pose_model = heavy).
